question: The ‘Mission Solar Charkha’ scheme was launched in the year 2018 by ________ of the Government of India.

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 'Mission Solar Charkha' scheme was launched by the **Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises** (MSME) in the year 2018.
 
• The scheme aims to increase employment opportunities and promote sustainable development in rural areas through the use of solar-powered charkhas (spinning wheels).
